sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM marts.fct_orders

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM marts.fct_orders

SELECT SUM(order_value) AS total_revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE purchase_date >= '2017-01-01'
  AND purchase_date < '2018-01-01'
  AND is_canceled = FALSE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS canceled_or_unavailable_orders
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE order_status IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM marts.dim_sellers
WHERE state = 'PR'

SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE customer_city = 'sao paulo'

SELECT AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT category_name) AS distinct_category_count
FROM marts.dim_products
WHERE category_name IS NOT NULL
  AND category_name != 'unknown'

SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE purchase_date >= '2018-01-01'
  AND purchase_date < '2019-01-01'
  AND is_canceled = FALSE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS boleto_order_count
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE primary_payment_type = 'boleto'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customer_count
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_canceled = FALSE
GROUP BY customer_unique_id
HAVING COUNT(order_id) >= 2

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS late_orders,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN is_late THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS late_delivery_rate_pct
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_delivered = TRUE

SELECT AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE purchase_date >= '2018-01-01'
  AND purchase_date < '2019-01-01'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM marts.dim_products
WHERE product_weight_g > 10000

SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS one_star_order_count
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE review_score = 1

SELECT
    state,
    COUNT(*) AS seller_count
FROM marts.dim_sellers
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY seller_count DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH order_quarter AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        d.year,
        d.quarter,
        o.items_value,
        o.freight_value
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    JOIN marts.dim_date d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2017
)
SELECT
    year,
    quarter,
    SUM(items_value + freight_value) AS total_billed_amount
FROM order_quarter
GROUP BY year, quarter
ORDER BY year, quarter

SELECT 
    customer_state,
    SUM(order_value) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE 
    YEAR(purchased_at) = 2018
GROUP BY 
    customer_state
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT
    SUM(oi.item_total_value) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi
JOIN marts.dim_date d
    ON oi.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE
    oi.category_name = 'health_beauty'
    AND d.year = 2017
    AND oi.is_canceled = FALSE

SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_orders_count
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE customer_state = 'RJ'
  AND is_late = TRUE

WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.delivery_days,
        d.month,
        d.month_name
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    JOIN marts.dim_date d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2017
      AND o.is_delivered = TRUE
)
SELECT
    month,
    month_name,
    AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM orders_2017
GROUP BY month, month_name
ORDER BY month

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS credit_card_share
FROM marts.fct_order_payments

SELECT 
    payment_type,
    SUM(payment_value) AS total_amount_paid
FROM 
    marts.fct_order_payments
GROUP BY 
    payment_type
ORDER BY 
    total_amount_paid DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
    d.year,
    COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
    SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_canceled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS canceled_orders,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.is_canceled THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS cancellation_rate_pct
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_date d
    ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
GROUP BY d.year
ORDER BY d.year

SELECT COUNT(customer_unique_id) AS first_order_customers_2018
FROM marts.dim_customers
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM first_order_at) = 2018

SELECT
    category_name,
    AVG(price) AS avg_item_price
FROM marts.fct_order_items
WHERE is_canceled = FALSE
GROUP BY category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000
ORDER BY avg_item_price DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders_with_more_than_3_items
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE item_count > 3

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN payment_installments >= 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS share_credit_card_10_plus_installments
FROM marts.fct_order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS active_sellers_2018
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi
JOIN marts.dim_date d ON oi.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE d.year = 2018
  AND oi.order_status != 'canceled'

SELECT SUM(order_value) AS total_amount_billed
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE purchase_date >= '2018-08-01'
  AND purchase_date < '2018-09-01'

SELECT
    d.month_name AS month,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_date d
    ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE d.year = 2017
GROUP BY d.month_name, d.month
ORDER BY order_count DESC, d.month ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  SUM(1) AS units_sold
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi
JOIN marts.dim_date d
  ON oi.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE d.year = 2018
  AND oi.category_name = 'bed_bath_table'
  AND oi.is_canceled = FALSE

SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_to_customer_at < estimated_delivery_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        2
    ) AS pct_early_delivery
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_delivered = TRUE

SELECT
    MEDIAN(delivery_days) AS median_delivery_days
FROM
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE
    is_delivered = TRUE

SELECT SUM(order_value) AS revenue
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE customer_state IN ('SP', 'RJ', 'MG', 'ES')
  AND order_status = 'delivered'

SELECT
    d.year,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_date d
    ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
GROUP BY d.year
ORDER BY d.year

SELECT
    primary_payment_type,
    AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY primary_payment_type
ORDER BY avg_review_score DESC

SELECT 
    customer_state,
    AVG(delivery_days) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM 
    marts.fct_orders
WHERE 
    is_delivered = TRUE
GROUP BY 
    customer_state
ORDER BY 
    avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(order_id) AS delivered_orders_2018
FROM marts.fct_orders
WHERE is_delivered = TRUE
  AND delivered_to_customer_at IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM delivered_to_customer_at) = 2018

SELECT 
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM purchased_at) AS hour_of_day,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM marts.fct_orders
GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM purchased_at)
ORDER BY order_count DESC, hour_of_day ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue_5_star_2018
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_date d ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE d.year = 2018
  AND o.review_score = 5
  AND o.order_status = 'delivered'

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        oi.category_name,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2017 THEN oi.item_total_value ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2017,
        SUM(CASE WHEN d.year = 2018 THEN oi.item_total_value ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2018
    FROM marts.fct_order_items oi
    JOIN marts.dim_date d
        ON oi.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year IN (2017, 2018)
      AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY oi.category_name
)
SELECT
    category_name,
    rev_2018 - rev_2017 AS revenue_growth
FROM category_revenue
ORDER BY revenue_growth DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT
  AVG(DATEDIFF('day', first_order_at, last_order_at)) AS avg_days_between_first_and_last_order
FROM marts.dim_customers
WHERE is_repeat_customer = TRUE

WITH seller_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        SUM(item_total_value) AS seller_revenue
    FROM marts.fct_order_items
    WHERE purchase_date >= '2017-01-01'
      AND purchase_date < '2018-01-01'
      AND order_status != 'canceled'
    GROUP BY seller_id
),
ranked_sellers AS (
    SELECT
        seller_id,
        seller_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY seller_revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM seller_revenue
),
top10_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(seller_revenue) AS top10_rev
    FROM ranked_sellers
    WHERE rn <= 10
),
total_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(seller_revenue) AS total_rev
    FROM seller_revenue
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (t10.top10_rev * 100.0) / tr.total_rev,
        2
    ) AS top10_revenue_share_pct
FROM top10_revenue t10
CROSS JOIN total_revenue tr

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        d.year_month,
        d.month_name,
        SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    JOIN marts.dim_date d ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE d.year = 2018
      AND d.month BETWEEN 1 AND 8
    GROUP BY d.year_month, d.month_name
)
SELECT
    year_month,
    month_name,
    revenue,
    ROUND(
        (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month),
        2
    ) AS pct_change
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY year_month

WITH state_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_state,
        COUNT(order_id) AS order_count
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    GROUP BY customer_state
    ORDER BY order_count DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
top_states AS (
    SELECT customer_state
    FROM state_order_counts
)
SELECT
    o.customer_state AS state,
    AVG(o.order_value) AS avg_order_value
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN top_states ts ON o.customer_state = ts.customer_state
GROUP BY o.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC

SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.payment_count > 1 THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS proportion_multi_payment
FROM marts.fct_orders o
JOIN marts.dim_date d ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
WHERE d.year = 2017

SELECT
    category_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS distinct_sellers
FROM marts.fct_order_items
WHERE category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY category_name
ORDER BY distinct_sellers DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(customer_unique_id) AS repeat_customers_2017_first_order
FROM marts.dim_customers
WHERE first_order_at >= '2017-01-01'
  AND first_order_at < '2018-01-01'
  AND is_repeat_customer = TRUE

WITH revenue_2018 AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        order_value,
        primary_payment_type
    FROM marts.fct_orders
    WHERE purchase_date >= '2018-01-01'
      AND purchase_date < '2019-01-01'
      AND order_status = 'delivered'
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN primary_payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN order_value ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(order_value), 0) AS credit_card_revenue_fraction
FROM revenue_2018

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN oi.seller_state = oi.customer_state THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS local_seller_share
FROM marts.fct_order_items oi
WHERE oi.is_canceled = FALSE

WITH order_reviews AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.review_score,
        d.is_weekend
    FROM marts.fct_orders o
    JOIN marts.dim_date d
        ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day
    WHERE o.review_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend'
        ELSE 'Weekday'
    END AS day_type,
    AVG(review_score) AS avg_review_score
FROM order_reviews
GROUP BY
    CASE
        WHEN is_weekend THEN 'Weekend'
        ELSE 'Weekday'
    END
ORDER BY
    day_type

WITH monthly_revenue AS (

        d.year_month,
        SUM(o.order_value) AS revenue

    JOIN marts.dim_date d ON o.purchase_date = d.date_day

SELECT

    revenue,
    ROUND(
        (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month)) * 100.0 / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY year_month),
        2

FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY year_month

        customer_state,

    ORDER BY order_count DESC

top_states AS (
